tools.name: ripples_launch_agent
tools.description: Creates an agent on Ripples: its token and market, its NFT collection, and the contract that holds its money. The contract is the launch's creator, so the creator's share of every trade fee (30% of the 1% fee on mainnet), and any creatorChargePercent set here, become the agent's working capital. The spending limits and the charge are fixed in this call and nobody, including the creator, can raise them afterwards. This is permanent: there is no pause, and losing the operator key ends the agent for good. Requires acknowledge: "permanent". It spends the runway, in WETH, and the network fee, in ETH, from this server's wallet. One launch runs at a time, and a repeat launch answers with the last one's treasury, or its transaction, until previousLaunch names it. It signs with RIPPLES_PRIVATE_KEY, and on mainnet it needs RIPPLES_ALLOW_MAINNET=1 and RIPPLES_MAX_PER_CALL.

name.description: The project's name, used for the token and the collection, at most 32 bytes.

symbol.description: The ticker, 1 to 10 letters or digits, written in capitals on chain.

image.description: A public link to the token's image, at most 512 bytes. The token carries it on chain.

description.description: What the project is, at most 2,048 bytes. The token carries it on chain.

website.description: A link to the project's website, at most 256 bytes. The token carries it on chain.

x.description: A link to the project's X profile, at most 256 bytes. The token carries it on chain.

mintPrice.description: Price per NFT, in the market's asset.

collectionSupply.description: How many pieces the collection holds, at least 1.

artworkBaseUri.description: Where the finished artwork lives, with a trailing slash.

creatorChargePercent.description: An extra charge on every trade in the agent's market, 0 to 10 percent in steps of 0.01, paid in full to its contract on top of the 1% trade fee. Fixed for good at launch. Leave it out for 0.

runway.description: What goes into the agent's contract, in the market's asset. Covers the launch fee and is what the agent works with until its market earns.

operator.description: The wallet that runs the agent: the only key that can ever spend from its contract, fixed for the life of the launch. Use a key that holds nothing else and run the agent from a server configured with it, since this server's wallet also funds the runway. An address that cannot sign leaves the agent inoperable.

dailySpend.description: Most it can spend in a day. Buys, mints and payouts share it. Give 0, with perCallSpend 0, for an agent that never spends.

perCallSpend.description: Most it can spend in one transaction, at most dailySpend. At least the mint price, or it can never mint.

dailySell.description: Most of its own token it can sell in a day. Leave it out and it can never sell.

dailyMint.description: Pieces it can mint a day. Leave it out and it can never mint.

items.description: An address the agent may pay, fixed for good at launch.

payees.description: The only addresses it will ever be able to pay, at most 8. Leave it out and it can pay nobody.

previousLaunch.description: The treasury address, or the transaction hash, this server's last launch answered with. Until a call names it, a repeat launch is refused and answers with it.

acknowledge.description: Required, and only "permanent": creating an agent cannot be undone. Its charter's limits and payees can never change, there is no pause, and losing the operator key ends the agent for good.

tools.name: ripples_agent_buy
tools.description: Buys the agent's own token on its own market, into its own contract. It spends the agent's money, inside the daily and per-transaction limits, and the network fee, in ETH, from this server's wallet. It signs with RIPPLES_PRIVATE_KEY, and on mainnet it needs RIPPLES_ALLOW_MAINNET=1 and RIPPLES_MAX_PER_CALL.

amount.description: How much of the market's asset to spend.

minReceived.description: The fewest tokens to accept. Leave it out for 99% of what the market quotes now.

tools.name: ripples_agent_sell
tools.description: Sells the agent's own token back into its market. It costs the network fee, in ETH, from this server's wallet. An agent launched without dailySell can never sell, and a sell from it, or one above what is left of today's ceiling, is refused before anything is sent. It signs with RIPPLES_PRIVATE_KEY, and on mainnet it needs RIPPLES_ALLOW_MAINNET=1.

amount.description: How much of its own token to sell.

minReceived.description: The least of the market's asset to accept. Leave it out for 99% of what the market quotes now.

tools.name: ripples_agent_mint
tools.description: Mints from the agent's own collection. The pieces stay with the agent, and the mint funds its own market like anyone else's. It spends the agent's money on the pieces, inside its limits, and the network fee, in ETH, from this server's wallet. It signs with RIPPLES_PRIVATE_KEY, and on mainnet it needs RIPPLES_ALLOW_MAINNET=1.

quantity.description: How many pieces to mint, 1 to 20, the most the collection mints at once.

minRouted.description: The least of the mint's payment, in the market's asset, that must reach the agent's market. Leave it out for 99% of what the mint routes now.

tools.name: ripples_agent_pay
tools.description: Pays one of the addresses the charter published, from the agent's money and inside its limits. Any other address is refused. It costs the network fee, in ETH, from this server's wallet. It signs with RIPPLES_PRIVATE_KEY, and on mainnet it needs RIPPLES_ALLOW_MAINNET=1 and RIPPLES_MAX_PER_CALL.

to.description: One of the payees the charter published at launch. Any other address is refused.

amount.description: How much of the market's asset to pay.

tools.name: ripples_agent_note
tools.description: Writes an entry in the agent's public run log, beside the transactions it describes. The text is committed as a hash and the `uri` is published next to it, so an entry with no `uri` is a dated digest nobody can read back. Pass a link to what the entry is about. It costs the network fee, in ETH, from this server's wallet. It signs with RIPPLES_PRIVATE_KEY, and on mainnet it needs RIPPLES_ALLOW_MAINNET=1.

text.description: The entry's text, committed on chain as its hash.

uri.description: A link to what the entry is about, at most 200 bytes.

tools.name: ripples_agent_claim
tools.description: Takes in what the launch has earned: the creator's share of every trade and the collection's share of every mint. The contract pays only the agent, whichever wallet sends the claim. What is owed is read first, and with nothing owed it is refused as nothing_to_claim before anything is sent. It costs the network fee, in ETH, from this server's wallet. It signs with RIPPLES_PRIVATE_KEY, and on mainnet it needs RIPPLES_ALLOW_MAINNET=1.

tools.name: ripples_agent_claim_vested
tools.description: Takes in the token slice the agent's own mints earned it. Separate from the fee claim because it only pays out once the market has reached its target, and a claim with nothing vested would otherwise fail the other one. How it claims follows how the launch keyed its vest, which ripples_agent_status says in capabilities.vestKeyedToPieces: when true, give tokenIds, pieces the treasury holds, and it takes in the slices tied to them; when false, leave tokenIds out. ripples_launch_agent keys an agent's vest to its wallet, so leave tokenIds out for the agents it makes. A claim made the other way is refused before anything is sent, saying which way to claim. It costs the network fee, in ETH, from this server's wallet. It signs with RIPPLES_PRIVATE_KEY, and on mainnet it needs RIPPLES_ALLOW_MAINNET=1.

tokenIds.description: Ids of pieces the treasury holds, to take in their slices when the launch keyed its vest to the pieces (capabilities.vestKeyedToPieces true). Leave it out when the vest is keyed to the wallet, as it is for an agent ripples_launch_agent made.

tools.name: ripples_agent_status
tools.description: What the agent may do, what is left of today's limits, what its treasury holds (budget.balance to spend, and budget.tokens, the most of its own token a sell can take), what its market and collection owe it now (owed, which ripples_agent_claim takes in), and the addresses of its launch. capabilities.vestKeyedToPieces says how its launch keyed its vest: true, so ripples_agent_claim_vested takes tokenIds; false, so it takes none; null when that cannot be told. capabilities.objectVesting says whether the treasury's contract can claim a vest keyed to pieces. owed or capabilities is left out when it cannot be read just then. With RIPPLES_TREASURY set, it needs no key. With no agent named, it says how to name or launch one.

tools.name: ripples_agent_activity
tools.description: Everything the agent has done, newest first, read from its own contract. With RIPPLES_TREASURY set, it needs no key.

limit.description: The most entries to answer with, 1 to 200. Leave it out for 25.

fromBlock.description: The block to read back to, asked for 10,000 blocks a request. Leave it out for the last 50,000 blocks; 0 reads back to the agent's launch, where its history starts.

tools.name: ripples_dual_fill_terms
tools.description: What a Crosscurrent on Solana and one EVM chain would take today: the chains priced (`chains`), what each side is priced in (`quotes`), the contracts it would use on each chain (`contracts`), the deadline range a create accepts (`deadline`), the launch deposit on each chain (`deposits`), each chain's target when openingBuy is given (`targets`), the opening price between the two (`gaps`), and which shapes this deployment serves (`offered`) and lets a new Crosscurrent take (`creatable`). The Solana side is priced in SOL, or in the admitted asset solanaQuote names. Nothing is saved or signed.

tools.name: ripples_dual_fill_create
tools.description: Creates a Crosscurrent: one token on Solana and one EVM chain, Robinhood Chain (ETH) or Arc (USDC), opened once both sides of the opening buy are full. `chains` names the pair. The Solana side is priced in SOL, or in an asset the launch program admits when solanaQuote names it, such as DKNGx; its holders are then paid in that asset, and its launch deposit stays in SOL. This server's wallets create both sides, and it spends the launch deposit on each chain plus network fees. Each deposit comes back with ripples_dual_fill_take_back_deposit once its side has opened or can no longer open. If a create stops part way, the refusal carries a receipt; call this again with it as `resume` to finish. It signs with RIPPLES_PRIVATE_KEY on each EVM chain and the Solana key (RIPPLES_SOLANA_KEYPAIR or RIPPLES_SOLANA_SECRET_KEY) on Solana, and on mainnet it needs RIPPLES_ALLOW_MAINNET=1 and RIPPLES_MAX_PER_CALL.

tools.name: ripples_dual_fill_create_agent
tools.description: Creates a Crosscurrent run by an agent, on Solana and one EVM chain. In this release it is refused before anything is signed: on mainnet as agent_not_on_network with Robinhood Chain and as program_mutable with Arc, and on the testnet as spend_window_upgrade_required. On each chain a contract is the creator, holds the agent's funds and receives the creator's income, under spending limits fixed at creation. The operator must be a key other than this server's; run the agent from a server holding that key. This server's wallet is the one that can stop the agent for good and, if a side does not open, take that side's agent funds back; both are done from ripples.run or the SDK, as this server has no tool for either. It spends each chain's runway, which covers that side's launch deposit, plus network fees. Creating an agent is permanent: there is no pause, and losing the operator key ends it for good. Requires acknowledge: "permanent". It signs with RIPPLES_PRIVATE_KEY on each EVM chain and the Solana key (RIPPLES_SOLANA_KEYPAIR or RIPPLES_SOLANA_SECRET_KEY) on Solana, and on mainnet it needs RIPPLES_ALLOW_MAINNET=1 and RIPPLES_MAX_PER_CALL.

tools.name: ripples_dual_fill_join
tools.description: Adds money to one side's opening buy, in what that side is priced in. Until publicUntil a side accepts more than its target, up to a quarter of it per wallet; after that it takes only what it still needs. On Solana each contribution is at least 0.01 SOL, or 10,000,000 base units of the asset the side is priced in, unless it fills the side. It spends the amount plus the network fee. It signs with RIPPLES_PRIVATE_KEY for a Robinhood Chain or Arc side and the Solana key (RIPPLES_SOLANA_KEYPAIR or RIPPLES_SOLANA_SECRET_KEY) for a Solana side, and on mainnet it needs RIPPLES_ALLOW_MAINNET=1 and RIPPLES_MAX_PER_CALL.

side.description: The chain whose side this acts on: robinhood, arc or solana.

amount.description: How much to add: ETH on Robinhood Chain, USDC on Arc, and on Solana SOL, or the asset the side is priced in, in that asset's decimal places.

payWith.description: quote pays the side's own quote, after an approval where that quote is a token. native pays the chain's own coin on a side that wraps it into its quote, as Robinhood Chain's testnet wraps ETH into WETH. Where the quote is the chain's own coin, as ETH is on Robinhood Chain mainnet, both pay it with no approval. On Arc, USDC is the gas as well as the quote. Leave it out for quote.

tools.name: ripples_dual_fill_withdraw
tools.description: Takes money back from a side that is still filling, before its deadline, in what that side is priced in. Withdrawals stop in the last five minutes before publicUntil. On Solana what stays in must be at least 0.01 SOL, or 10,000,000 base units of the asset the side is priced in, unless all of it comes back. It costs only the network fee. It signs with RIPPLES_PRIVATE_KEY for a Robinhood Chain or Arc side and the Solana key (RIPPLES_SOLANA_KEYPAIR or RIPPLES_SOLANA_SECRET_KEY) for a Solana side, and on mainnet it needs RIPPLES_ALLOW_MAINNET=1.

It signs with RIPPLES_PRIVATE_KEY for a Robinhood Chain or Arc side and the Solana key (RIPPLES_SOLANA_KEYPAIR or RIPPLES_SOLANA_SECRET_KEY) for a Solana side, and on mainnet it needs RIPPLES_ALLOW_MAINNET=1.

On its EVM chain it also says what is left of today's selling limit (`sell`) and how many of its tokens it may sell (`sellableTokens`). A side not created yet is null. On Solana, `spendWindow` gives the state of the agent's rolling 24-hour spending window; in this release it is upgrade_required on both networks, and `spend` there is 0, as the pinned Solana program has no such window. It needs no key.

It costs the network fee and the window account's rent, from this server's Solana wallet, and the agent then waits 24 hours before it spends on Solana again. In this release it is refused as spend_window_upgrade_required on both networks, before anything is signed, as the pinned Solana program has no such window. It signs with the Solana key (RIPPLES_SOLANA_KEYPAIR or RIPPLES_SOLANA_SECRET_KEY), and on mainnet it needs RIPPLES_ALLOW_MAINNET=1.

It spends the agent's funds, and the network fee from this server's wallet. It signs with RIPPLES_PRIVATE_KEY for a Robinhood Chain or Arc side and the Solana key (RIPPLES_SOLANA_KEYPAIR or RIPPLES_SOLANA_SECRET_KEY) for a Solana side, and on mainnet it needs RIPPLES_ALLOW_MAINNET=1 and RIPPLES_MAX_PER_CALL.

tools.name: ripples_dual_fill_agent_pay
tools.description: Pays one of the addresses the agent's charter fixed at creation, from the agent's funds and inside its limits. Run it from a server whose keys are the agent's operator keys. In this release a Solana side is refused as spend_window_upgrade_required, before anything is signed. The network fee comes from this server's wallet. It signs with RIPPLES_PRIVATE_KEY for a Robinhood Chain or Arc side and the Solana key (RIPPLES_SOLANA_KEYPAIR or RIPPLES_SOLANA_SECRET_KEY) for a Solana side, and on mainnet it needs RIPPLES_ALLOW_MAINNET=1 and RIPPLES_MAX_PER_CALL.

tools.name: ripples_dual_fill_agent_note

Pass the text and the server hashes its UTF-8 bytes, as ripples_agent_note does, or pass that hash as digest. Run it from a server whose keys are the agent's operator keys. It costs only the network fee. It signs with RIPPLES_PRIVATE_KEY for a Robinhood Chain or Arc side and the Solana key (RIPPLES_SOLANA_KEYPAIR or RIPPLES_SOLANA_SECRET_KEY) for a Solana side, and on mainnet it needs RIPPLES_ALLOW_MAINNET=1.

tools.name: ripples_crosscurrent_status

When pricing cannot be read, it still answers whether launches are open, and names what it could not read in `unread`. Nothing is saved or signed.

tools.name: ripples_crosscurrent_progress
tools.description: Where a Crosscurrent launch stands: each market's phase as Ripples last observed it, the token on each chain, and its page. Nothing is signed.

launch.description: The 0x id at the end of the launch page's address, in lowercase.

tools.name: ripples_crosscurrent_launch
tools.description: Launches a token and its collection on Robinhood Chain, Arc and Solana from this server's wallet. It takes four signatures on the home chain (signing in, two for ownership and the launch transaction), plus an approval where the home chain settles in a token. Ripples' executor then opens the other two markets, usually within seven minutes. The wallet pays the opening buy for all three markets, the launch fee and the two bridge fees on the home chain, in that chain's own money (ETH on Robinhood Chain, USDC on Arc). Artwork is a folder inside RIPPLES_MEDIA_DIR with the pieces named 1.png, 2.png and so on. Holder rewards, when on, route every future creator trading fee on Robinhood Chain and Arc to holders as the markets open, for good. Requires acknowledge: "permanent". It waits for the markets to open unless wait is false. An answer of Launched, or the code launch_sent, means the launch went through: follow it with ripples_crosscurrent_progress and do not launch again. The code launch_unconfirmed names a transaction that may still land: follow it the same way before anything else. The codes launch_interrupted and launch_reverted name a reservation that ripples_crosscurrent_resume finishes. A repeat launch answers with this server's last one until previousLaunch names it or that launch is resumed to the end. It signs with RIPPLES_PRIVATE_KEY, and on mainnet it needs RIPPLES_ALLOW_MAINNET=1 and RIPPLES_MAX_PER_CALL.

acknowledge.description: Required, and only "permanent": the token, its supply on three chains and its collection are created for good, and holder rewards, when on, are permanent.

tools.name: ripples_crosscurrent_resume
tools.description: Finishes a launch this server's wallet reserved but did not send: it signs for ownership if that is still owed, waits for Ripples to create the bridges, then pays and records, as ripples_crosscurrent_launch does from the reservation on. Use it after a launch answered launch_interrupted or launch_reverted. If the chain shows the launch already went through, the answer carries its page; follow it with ripples_crosscurrent_progress. It signs with RIPPLES_PRIVATE_KEY, and on mainnet it needs RIPPLES_ALLOW_MAINNET=1 and RIPPLES_MAX_PER_CALL.

launch.description: The 0x id at the end of the launch page's address, in lowercase.

wait.description: Whether to wait for every market to open before answering. Leave it out to wait.

tools.name: ripples_crosscurrent_name_solana_payout
tools.description: Names the Solana wallet a launch's creator share of the Solana market's fees goes to: this server's Solana wallet, which signs one message. It cannot be changed afterwards, so it requires acknowledge: "permanent". Until a wallet is named, the fees wait on the launch. It signs with the Solana key (RIPPLES_SOLANA_KEYPAIR or RIPPLES_SOLANA_SECRET_KEY) and signs in with RIPPLES_PRIVATE_KEY, the wallet that reserved the launch, and on mainnet it needs RIPPLES_ALLOW_MAINNET=1.

launch.description: The 0x id at the end of the launch page's address, in lowercase.

acknowledge.description: Required, and only "permanent": the creator's share of the Solana market's fees goes to this wallet for good.

tools.name: ripples_collect
tools.description: Takes in everything this server's wallet is owed on Robinhood Chain, in one pass: the creator fee of each of its launches, per asset; the proceeds of each collection it created; the token slice its mints vested, whether the vest belongs to the wallet or to the pieces it holds; holder periods the publisher could not push to it; and a paired launch's stock rewards. Each claim is read first and sent only with something to pay, and every contract pays the wallet whichever address sends the claim. It answers with what was sent and what was skipped, and why. It costs the network fee, in ETH, from this server's wallet, once per claim sent. It signs with RIPPLES_PRIVATE_KEY, and on mainnet it needs RIPPLES_ALLOW_MAINNET=1.

launches.description: Launch token addresses to collect from instead of this wallet's own launches: a minter names the launches it minted into. Holder periods and stock rewards are collected either way.

tools.name: ripples_bind_token
tools.description: Makes a token this server's wallet holds an agent: registers it as an ERC-8004 agent through the ERC-8217 adapter on Robinhood Chain or Base, so whoever holds the token controls the agent, and control moves with a sale. Answers the agent's number, its 8004scan page and the ripples.run link that launches a market from it, whose creator income then goes to whoever holds the token. A token the wallet does not hold is refused before anything is sent. Each call makes another agent, so bind a token once. It costs the network fee, in ETH, from this server's wallet. It signs with RIPPLES_PRIVATE_KEY, and on mainnet it needs RIPPLES_ALLOW_MAINNET=1.

tools.name: ripples_pin_wake
tools.description: Points the creator income of a launch this server's wallet made at a piece, so the income is paid to whoever holds the piece and goes with it when the piece is sold. Creates the piece's payee first where it does not exist yet. This is permanent: nobody, this wallet included, can point the income anywhere else afterward. Requires acknowledge: "permanent". Refused before anything is sent when this wallet does not receive the launch's creator fee, when the income already goes to a piece or to holders, or when the piece has no holder on that chain. It costs the network fee, in ETH, from this server's wallet, for one or two transactions. It signs with RIPPLES_PRIVATE_KEY, and on mainnet it needs RIPPLES_ALLOW_MAINNET=1.

tools.name: ripples_wake
tools.description: What a piece's wake holds on Robinhood Chain or Base: the markets launched from it, what is owed now, read from the chain, what has been paid and the last payout, who holds the piece, and the payee that pays it. Amounts are in each currency's smallest unit, with its symbol and decimals. Answers wake: null when no market pays the piece directly and the Ripples API lists no split that pays it; read a split you know with ripples_wake_split. Needs no key.

tools.name: ripples_release_wake
tools.description: Pays everything a piece's markets owe it to whoever holds the piece now. A holder share that owes the creator's part to the piece is brought up to date first, then the piece's payee pays out each currency it holds. Anyone may send it, and it pays only the holder; nothing owed sends nothing. A step the chain refuses before anything is signed for it, such as a currency the holder cannot take, is answered in skipped and the rest still goes out. It costs the network fee, in ETH, from this server's wallet, once per transaction sent. It signs with RIPPLES_PRIVATE_KEY, and on mainnet it needs RIPPLES_ALLOW_MAINNET=1.

tools.name: ripples_share_wake
tools.description: Shares the creator income of a launch this server's wallet made between up to 256 pieces on Robinhood Chain or Base. Each piece is owed its part, paid to whoever holds the piece when it is paid out, so a piece's part goes with it when it is sold. Creates the split for the pieces first where it does not exist yet. This is permanent: nobody, this wallet included, can change which pieces share the income or in what parts. Requires acknowledge: "permanent". Refused before anything is sent when a piece has no holder on that chain, when a piece is named twice or with a weight of 0, when this wallet does not receive the launch's creator fee, or when the income already goes to a piece, to pieces or to holders. It costs the network fee, in ETH, from this server's wallet, for one or two transactions. It signs with RIPPLES_PRIVATE_KEY, and on mainnet it needs RIPPLES_ALLOW_MAINNET=1.

weight.description: The piece's parts of the wake. Each piece is owed its weight over the total of every piece's weight. Leave it out for 1.

pieces.description: The pieces that share the wake, up to 256, each named once and in any order. The split keeps them ascending by collection, then by token id.

acknowledge.description: Required, and only "permanent": the launch's creator income is shared by these pieces for good.

Amounts are in each currency's smallest unit, with its symbol and decimals. Needs no key.

tools.name: ripples_release_split
tools.description: Pays each piece of a split its part of the income the split receives, to whoever holds the piece now. A holder share that owes the split the creator's part is brought up to date first, then the split pays out each currency, at most 64 pieces a transaction. Anyone may send it, and it pays only the pieces' holders. Answers each piece paid and each piece that could not be paid, whose part stays owed to it. A piece with no holder, or one the split itself holds, is listed without being sent, and nothing owed sends nothing. It costs the network fee, in ETH, from this server's wallet, once per transaction sent. It signs with RIPPLES_PRIVATE_KEY, and on mainnet it needs RIPPLES_ALLOW_MAINNET=1.

chain.description: Robinhood Chain (4663) or Base (8453): the chain the piece is on, and its markets with it.
